svg.title: Otto cycle
svg.desc: A PV diagram of a simplified Otto cycle: adiabatic compression A to B, heating at constant volume B to C (heat Q_h, from the internal energy ΔU of burning fuel), adiabatic expansion C to D, and cooling at constant volume D to A (heat Q_c out). Beside it, the equivalent heat engine: ΔU creates Q_h; W, proportional to the shaded area of the PV diagram, is done; and Q_c goes to the cold reservoir.
